how: We read the website of every Philadelphia wedding DJ listed on Lazo (102 listings, 83 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national chain's city page, a parked site, a string quartet company, a photo-and-video company with a DJ add-on, and companies based an hour-plus away in North and Central Jersey. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign, not just the booking office?
How do you handle a ceremony outdoors and a reception inside, or two rooms at a historic venue? Ask about a second sound system and the venue's noise cutoff.
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and overtime on top?

picks.name: SEK PRODUCTIONS
picks.blurb: Chris DiNardo started DJing at 16 as a career decision and trained with Philadelphia and South Jersey DJs before building SEK Productions. The site offers two packages with clear pricing and no hidden fees, plus event lighting, for Cherry Hill, Philadelphia and the Shore points.

picks.name: Stampone Weddings
picks.blurb: Mike Stampone runs Stampone Weddings himself as an all-in-one wedding entertainment service for Philly and beyond. A husband and father, he says becoming one shaped how he approaches every wedding, from an intimate ceremony to a grand affair.

picks.name: DJ WESS
picks.blurb: DJ Wess brings a structured approach: each set is prepared in advance and adjusted in real time, and every event starts with listening to the vision, venue and audience. Based in Wilmington, with packages printed on the site and a $100 deposit at contract signing.

picks.name: DJ Bill Scheivert
picks.blurb: Bill Scheivert is a wedding DJ and MC with decades of experience serving Delaware County, Pennsylvania and New Castle County, Delaware. His site lays out Essential and Signature packages and a most-complete tier so you can see what each adds.

picks.name: Silver Sound Entertainment
picks.blurb: Silver Sound grew from a one-man system into nearly twenty active DJs serving the Delaware Valley, with a photo gallery going back to the 1980s. The company is built around sound quality and offers add-on services to turn a wedding into what it calls a signature celebration.

picks.name: Rock It Entertainment
picks.blurb: Rock It Entertainment in Pennsauken is neither just a DJ nor just a band: a DJ blended with an electronic drummer, an interactive sax player and production. The pitch is a modern alternative to predictable wedding entertainment, based in New Jersey and available worldwide.

picks.name: On The Beat Fx
picks.blurb: On The Beat Fx was started with one intention: wedding entertainment that feels personal and tied to each couple's story and the music they grew up with. The Cherry Hill company offers DJs, musicians and photo booths, and covers ceremony, cocktail hour and reception across separate rooms or outdoors.

picks.name: Curran Entertainment
picks.blurb: Greg Curran, DJ Greggie C, has been a mobile DJ for 30 years with a focus on weddings, including 25 years as Director of Production for a national DJ, video and photography company before going out on his own. Curran Entertainment in Abington is family-owned, licensed and insured, with photo booths and officiants available.

picks.name: All Party Starz DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: All Party Starz prints wedding packages from $1,145 and says every one can be trimmed to what your day needs. Tori started as a karaoke singer, grew into DJing and now runs the Lancaster team with a family-run feel for the Reading and Lancaster region.

picks.name: D Js Available Sound & Light
picks.blurb: DJs Available Sound and Light is a Moorestown company of disc jockeys who MC and host the event, with cordless mics and a library from country and Top 40 to hip-hop and club. The Addison Chamber Players handle live music for ceremonies and cocktail hours.

picks.name: Schaffer Sound Productions, Inc.
picks.blurb: Ken Schaffer started Schaffer Sound at fourteen in 1977, playing grade-school dances, and the students he played for later hired him for their weddings. Still family-owned and operated in Media, and positioned as local Philadelphia wedding DJ specialists.

picks.name: Jeanyo Entertainment
picks.blurb: Jeanyo Entertainment calls itself an upscale entertainment experience rather than an average DJ company, with a Philadelphia team personally trained and hand-picked by DJ Jeanyo. Over 12 years of events across Top 40, classics, Caribbean, Afrobeats, hip-hop, Latin, rock and pop.
